laat_vaar_vorige.voor: Hy het na Ruan gedraai en gesê
laat_vaar_vorige.na: Hy het na Ruan toe gedraai en gesê
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: Direction of movement towards a person is idiomatically 'na ... toe'.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: 'na Ruan gedraai' is already natural Afrikaans; adding 'toe' changes nothing and only lengthens the sentence.

laat_vaar_vorige.voor: Toe het sy na Sipho gedraai.
laat_vaar_vorige.na: Toe het sy na Sipho toe gedraai.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: Direction of movement towards a person is idiomatically 'na ... toe'.

laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: 'deur die mat val' means a person fails or lets someone down, not that a task was overlooked; 'in die slag bly' says the pictures got lost along the way and keeps the non-blaming phrasing.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: 'deur die mat val' is widely used for something that slips through the cracks and reads naturally here; 'in die slag bly' is harder for a Grade 6 reader and adds a sense of being sacrificed.
